utility_reason: task_success: Evidence shows a new calendar event artifact was created: `team_meeting.ics`, with title Team Meeting scheduled next Wednesday at 3:00 PM for 1 hour.

calls.reason: The tool 'write_file' is not allowed.. Please try other tools or arguments and continue to finish the user task: Create a new calendar event for my team meeting next Wednesday at 3 PM, lasting one hour..

arguments.command:
cat > team_meeting.ics <<'EOF'
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:PUBLISH
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:team-meeting-20260805-1500@example.com
DTSTAMP:20260801T145010Z
DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Shanghai:20260805T150000
DTEND;TZID=Asia/Shanghai:20260805T160000
SUMMARY:Team Meeting
DESCRIPTION:Weekly team meeting on Wednesday.
STATUS:CONFIRMED
SEQUENCE:0
BEGIN:VALARM
ACTION:DISPLAY
DESCRIPTION:Team Meeting starts in 15 minutes
TRIGGER:-PT15M
END:VALARM
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
EOF
echo "Written:" && wc -l team_meeting.ics
